title: Seev data retention policy (docs/roadmap/active/51 K1)
description: Validates config/data-retention.yaml (parsed as JSON). Enforced by cmd/retentioncheck.

policy_version.description: Current writable policy version. Every entry's own policy_version must be <= this value.

permanent_tables.description: owner.table pairs where no entry may fully DELETE a row (redact/retain_* only).

owner.description: The one service that loads this entry at runtime, or 'shared' for cross-cutting infrastructure classes with no single owning service.

class.description: Globally unique policy class id, e.g. 'ledger.fee_quotes.unconsumed'. Multiple classes may target the same table when eligibility differs by row state.

table.description: owner.table for a real Postgres table this entry governs, cross-checked against every migrations/<owner>/*.up.sql CREATE TABLE. Null for a non-Postgres class (object store, Redis, RabbitMQ, logs/traces, backups) — use object_class instead.

object_class.description: Required when table is null: a short human-readable description of the non-Postgres data class this entry governs.

terminal_timestamp.description: The column (or short SQL expression over the table's own columns) that anchors eligibility, e.g. 'expires_at' or 'COALESCE(revoked_at, expires_at)'. Null for actions with no age component (retain_state, retain_permanent, retain_immutable, self_replacing, not_persisted, protected_by_masking, expiration_based, pseudonymize_on_closure, never_automatic).

duration.description: Grace period after terminal_timestamp before the row/field becomes eligible, e.g. '24h', '30d', '365d'. Null when action has no age component.

batch_size.description: Max rows per owner-function transaction (K6). 0 for actions with no batched row processing.

hold_scope.description: Which K5 retention-hold scope, if any, can block this entry's eligibility.

notes.description: Cites the exact docs/roadmap/active/51 section this entry implements, or states explicitly that it is a T0 judgment call extending beyond the locked matrix.
